text: This report for action is about a matter that the Etobicoke Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. The subject matter is an amended application for a boulevard café permit – change of ownership.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the application for an outdoor patio license agreement at 3311-3313 Bloor Street West, with the following conditions: 1. Comply at all times with regulation set out in the former Metropolitan Toronto, By-Law 41093, as amended or its successor by-law. 2. The City of Toronto business license be maintained by the applicant and in addition, include an endorsement for the "outside patio". 3. The area of the boulevard café located on the City of Toronto right-of-way be no greater than 11.25 metres along Bloor Street West and no greater than 1.50 metres along the Eagle Road flankage representing a total area of the boulevard café to approximately 17.0 square metres. 4.
